def VTask.subtypePreimage {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (x₀ : {a : α // p a} → β) : {x // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀} ≃ ({a : α // ¬p a} → β) where
  toFun := λ x => λ a => x a
  invFun := λ y => 
    let x : α → β := λ a => 
      if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, h⟩
    have proof : x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ := by ext a; simp [x]
    ⟨x, proof⟩
  left_inv := by
    intro y
    ext a
    simp [toFun, invFun]
    refl
  right_inv := by
    intro x
    cases x
    ext a
    simp [toFun, invFun]
    by_cases h : p a
    · rw [← x_property ⟨a, h⟩]
      rfl
    · rfl
